derivation: The stdout is a single JSON object, so parseRouting takes the braced candidate and returns all seven keys.
The oracle expects route/TD/bmad-testarch-test-design. The action, the menu code and the workflow all match, so
actionCorrect, menuCorrect, workflowCorrect and routeCorrect are all true.
decidingTokens is [risk, coverage] and the reason carries both words outright, so tokensFound is 2 of 2.
scopeTokens is [epic 4] and the scope reads "epic 4, the tenant data export work", which is 35 characters
against a 197-character message, so it clears the half-the-message bound and scopeOk is true.
